section_summary.extract_value: This section describes an exploratory factor analysis (EFA) of the Portuguese Acceptance of Cosmetic Surgery Scale (ACSS) with 15 items. Three factors emerged explaining 61.9% of the variance, with good internal consistency (Cronbach's α = .91 for overall score). Independent sample t-tests revealed no significant sex differences on the overall ACSS score or most subscales, though women scored significantly higher on the Consider subscale.
